6438.title: Catalog tab closures overwrite earlier changes
6438.rootCauseOneLine: Bulk-close callbacks each replace the workspace from the same render-captured tab list; unconditional navigation can also restore a removed active tab.

prReviews.verdict: Static approach matches the verified root cause; not execution-verified
prReviews.topFinding: Reads current workspace state before each close, synchronizes selection before navigation, and avoids navigation when an inactive tab closes. No PR code was checked out or executed.

6438.proposedFix: Apply closes to current workspace state, synchronize the selected survivor before the bulk loop, and navigate only when the active tab changes. Existing PR #6439 already targets this path.
6438.caveats: Four regression cases fail in each of two clean trusted-main checkouts. Browser screenshots were blocked: no system Chrome and a temporary official Chrome tool lacked system shared libraries. No repository dependency was added. Electron and iOS Safari were not tested. No duplicate fix PR was opened because #6439 is open and explicitly closes #6438.
